generators.carrier: complex matrices on adjoint fermion fields over lattice sites

relations.statement: The adjoint rep of SU(2) is real: there is a basis in which every adjoint link matrix is real orthogonal, so there is an antiunitary K (complex conjugation composed with a fixed unitary) commuting with the gauge-field part of D_adj.
relations.hypotheses: adjoint representation real; Dirac structure admits compatible antiunitary (e.g. staggered or Wilson with charge-conjugation-type symmetry); Dirac Hermiticity-type relation holds for the chosen discretization

relations.statement: If U D U^{-1} = conj(D) for some invertible U then det D = conj(det D), so det D is real.
relations.hypotheses: D a finite square complex matrix; U invertible

lemmas.statement: For all SU(2) lattice gauge configurations, if D_adj satisfies U D U^{-1} = conj(D), then det D_adj is real.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem det_real_of_conj {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (D U : Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : IsUnit U.det) (h : U * D * U⁻¹ = D.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) : (D.det).im = 0 := by sorry

near_misses.claim: det D_adj is real therefore nonnegative, so the sign problem is absent for a single Majorana flavor
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Reality does not imply positivity; for a single Majorana flavor the measure is a Pfaffian whose sign can change.

near_misses.claim: Hermiticity of the discrete Dirac operator test on a simplicial pair establishes the antiunitary symmetry of the SU(2) adjoint lattice operator
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: That test concerns a different, gravitational simplicial operator and Hermiticity, not an antiunitary symmetry of the SU(2) adjoint Dirac operator.

open_obligations: No existing declaration in the sources builds a lattice adjoint Dirac operator; both generators are proposed_new.
